// Read-only observer for the black-box stock install smoke. No authority is minted.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"

	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/bootstrap"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/evidencecas"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/newtransaction"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/ossinstall"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/provenance"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/resources"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/state"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/stateledger"
	"github.com/tplAIter/tplaiter/internal/trustload"
)

func main() {
	if err := verify(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func verify() error {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	reg, err := ossinstall.DecodeRegistration(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	runtime, err := trustload.OpenRuntime(context.Background(), trustload.RuntimeOptions{Selection: reg.Selection(), ProjectKey: os.Args[2], Clock: bootstrap.ClockFunc(time.Now)})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer runtime.Close()
	p := runtime.ProjectContext()
	rootPath := p.RootPath
	if len(os.Args) == 5 {
		rootPath = os.Args[4]
	}
	loaded, err := trustload.Load(context.Background(), reg.Selection())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cas, err := evidencecas.NewFSReader(loaded.Install.EvidenceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer cas.Close()
	if _, err := stateledger.VerifyStable(context.Background(), rootPath, runtime.TrustRuntime(), stateledger.StableVerifyOptions{CAS: cas}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	marker, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(rootPath, ".tplaiter", "project.yaml"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var project stateledger.ProjectV2
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(marker, &project); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if project.ID != p.ProjectID {
		return fmt.Errorf("marker/context identity mismatch")
	}
	journals, err := newtransaction.List(os.Args[3])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(journals) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("unfinished creation journal")
	}
	rootRaw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(rootPath, ".tplaiter", "root-template.lock.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	root, err := provenance.DecodeRootTemplateLock(rootRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lockRaw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(rootPath, resources.NativeResourceLockPath))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lock, err := resources.DecodeResourceLockV2(lockRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	images := &resources.ResourceImages{Lock: *lock, Files: map[string][]byte{}}
	for _, artifact := range lock.Artifacts {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(rootPath, artifact.Path))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		images.Files[artifact.Path] = data
	}
	if err := images.Validate(*root); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	projects, err := state.LoadProjects(os.Args[3])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(projects.Items) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("expected exactly two project entries")
	}
	found := false
	for _, item := range projects.Items {
		if item.ID == p.ProjectID && item.Path == p.RootPath {
			found = true
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry identity absent: %s", p.ProjectID)
	}
	fmt.Printf("stable registry verified: %s\n", p.ProjectID)
	return nil
}
